ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t11: Cost savings: why CPO iPhone and iPad reduce your investment
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t12: Apple Certified Refurbished product delivers the same experience as a new device at a significantly lower cost. For a business or distributor, that difference translates into freed-up budget and margin.
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t14: When you compare a new device with its equivalent
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t16: , the price difference is significant, while the difference in experience is practically nil. An iPhone or iPad officially refurbished by Apple arrives with a new battery, new housing and full functional testing: the customer receives a device equivalent to a new one, but the investment required to get it into their hands is much lower.
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t17: Less investment per unit, without losing quality
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t18: The savings don't mean giving up anything that matters. The product keeps 100% original parts, the battery starts at 100% health, and Apple's official one-year warranty comes with every unit. For a professional buyer, this means lowering acquisition cost without taking on the quality risk associated with unofficial refurbishment.
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t19: More units with the same budget
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t20: For a company renewing its fleet of phones and tablets, or a school rolling out iPad in classrooms, the lower cost per device makes it possible to cover more seats with the same budget line. The freed-up budget can go toward more devices, accessories or other priorities.
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t22: For distributors, carriers and resellers, CPO is a product with
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t24: . It combines a globally recognized premium brand with a more accessible entry price, which makes it easier to sell and improves the price-to-margin ratio compared with a new device.
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t25: A lower total cost of ownership
ahorro-de-costes-iphone-ipad-cpo.t26: The savings go beyond the purchase price. Because it's a product with official warranty and support through Apple-authorized channels, after-sales costs and incidents are reduced, which lowers the total cost of ownership over the device's lifetime.

cpo-acceso-tecnologia.t18: CPO iPhone and iPad bring high-end devices within reach of buyers who would otherwise choose lower-priced brands. For the channel, this expands the potential market: Apple product gets sold to customers who were previously out of reach.

cpo-sostenibilidad-medio-ambiente.t11: Sustainability: how CPO reduces production and emissions
cpo-sostenibilidad-medio-ambiente.t12: Most of a smartphone's carbon footprint is generated during manufacturing. Extending the life of each device is one of the most effective ways to reduce the environmental impact of technology.
cpo-sostenibilidad-medio-ambiente.t14: More and more companies are factoring environmental criteria into their purchasing decisions. The
cpo-sostenibilidad-medio-ambiente.t16: product fits squarely into that logic: instead of manufacturing a device from scratch, an existing one is refurbished and put back on the market with quality equivalent to a new device.
cpo-sostenibilidad-medio-ambiente.t17: The biggest impact is in manufacturing
cpo-sostenibilidad-medio-ambiente.t18: For a smartphone, the largest share of CO₂ emissions isn't generated during use, but during manufacturing: material extraction, component production and assembly. That's why extending the life of an already-manufactured device avoids a very significant portion of that footprint.
cpo-sostenibilidad-medio-ambiente.t20: Every CPO iPhone or iPad that enters circulation is a new unit that doesn't need to be produced. This reduces demand for raw materials, the water and energy consumption tied to manufacturing, and e-waste generation by extending the product's life cycle.
cpo-sostenibilidad-medio-ambiente.t22: CPO represents circular economy without compromise: refurbishment is carried out by Apple, with original parts and quality control, so sustainability doesn't come at the expense of reliability. It's a responsible alternative that is also safe.
cpo-sostenibilidad-medio-ambiente.t23: A case to make to your corporate customers
cpo-sostenibilidad-medio-ambiente.t24: For companies with sustainability goals or ESG reporting, choosing refurbished devices is a measurable, communicable decision. Distributing CPO lets you offer your customers a premium product that also contributes to their environmental goals.

cpo-vs-reacondicionado-no-oficial.t12: Not all refurbishment is the same. The difference between a CPO product and one refurbished by a third party comes down to who certifies it and what backing it arrives with.
cpo-vs-reacondicionado-no-oficial.t14: The refurbished market has very different quality levels coexisting side by side. Understanding the difference between a
cpo-vs-reacondicionado-no-oficial.t16: device and an unofficially refurbished one is key for a professional buyer, because it directly affects returns, reputation and regulatory risk.
cpo-vs-reacondicionado-no-oficial.t18: With CPO, refurbishment is carried out by Apple. Every unit goes through strict quality control, with 100% original parts, a new battery and a new outer housing. With third-party refurbishment, neither the origin of the parts nor the process is guaranteed consistently.

cpo-vs-reacondicionado-no-oficial.t29: and complies with EU telecommunications regulations, which brings legal certainty to distribution. That traceability dramatically reduces regulatory risk and return rates compared with unbacked refurbishment.
cpo-vs-reacondicionado-no-oficial.t31: With an official warranty and support through Apple-authorized channels, after-sales handling goes through the manufacturer. This lowers your own support costs and protects the distributor's reputation, something unofficial refurbishment can hardly offer.
